**Result: I cannot compute the embedded emissions for this shipment under the supplied ruleset.**

**Inputs checked**

| Required input | Provided | Status |
|---|---|---|
| (a) Good CN code in the factor table | CN 7202 11 (ferro-manganese, > 2% carbon) | ❌ **Not in table** |
| (b) Country of production listed for that good | China | ❌ Cannot be matched, because the CN code is absent |
| (c) Quantity in tonnes | 500 t | ✅ Provided |

**Missing input**

- **The default SEE (tCO2e/t) for CN 7202 11, ferro-manganese with > 2% carbon, produced in China.** The table only covers CN 7201, 7206 10 00, 7207 11 90 and 7214 20 00. It has no entry for any 7202 (ferro-alloy) code, for China or any other country.

**Why no estimate is given**

The ruleset selects the SEE jointly by CN code and country, and it says not to estimate if either is missing. Using a factor from another code would be a substitution the rules don't allow. That includes pig iron (7201, China: 1.66 tCO2e/t), which is a different good. Ferro-manganese is made by a different process and has a different emissions profile.

**To complete the calculation, please provide** an updated factor table with the default SEE for CN 7202 11 (> 2% C), country of production China. With that value, the result would be:

Embedded emissions = SEE (7202 11, China) × 500 t, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.
